query_plan.label: full_table_summary
query_plan.sql:
WITH doc_parts AS (
 SELECT source_id,court,substr(decision_date,1,10) date_token,
 CAST(substr(decision_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) y,CAST(substr(decision_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) m,
 CAST(substr(decision_date,9,2) AS INTEGER) day,
 CASE WHEN trim(citation)<>'' AND trim(source_id)<>'' AND source_id<>court||'_'
 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END valid_source_id,trim(citation)='' empty_citation,trim(decision_date)='' empty_date
 FROM documents WHERE run_id=?
), doc_years AS (
 SELECT source_id,court,valid_source_id,empty_citation,empty_date,
 CASE WHEN date_token GLOB '[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
 AND m BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND day BETWEEN 1 AND CASE
 WHEN m=2 THEN CASE WHEN y%4=0 AND (y%100<>0 OR y%400=0) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END
 WHEN m IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END THEN y END year
 FROM doc_parts
), d AS (
 SELECT source_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT court)=1 THEN MIN(court) ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END court,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(year)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT year)=1 THEN MIN(year) END year,
 COUNT(*) corpus_rows,MIN(valid_source_id) valid_source_id,
 SUM(empty_citation) empty_citation_rows,SUM(empty_date) empty_date_rows
 FROM doc_years GROUP BY source_id
), b AS (
 SELECT e.*,g.name group_name,g.dd global_dd,g.kept,
 COALESCE(d.court,'UNKNOWN') source_court,d.year source_year,
 CASE WHEN d.year IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(d.year/10 AS INTEGER)*10 END decade,
 CASE WHEN e.foreign_status IN ('FOREIGN','DOMESTIC_CA')
 AND e.origin_country<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END origin_known,
 CASE WHEN e.group_origin_status='DETERMINED' AND e.group_origin_country<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END group_origin_known,
 CASE WHEN d.source_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END missing_document_metadata
 FROM citation_edges e NOT INDEXED CROSS JOIN case_groups g ON g.run_id=e.run_id AND g.group_id=e.resolved_cited_case
 LEFT JOIN d ON d.source_id=e.source_decision AND d.valid_source_id=1 WHERE e.run_id=? AND g.dd>=? AND e.foreign_status=?)
SELECT COUNT(*) citation_edges,COUNT(DISTINCT source_decision) citing_source_ids,
 COUNT(DISTINCT resolved_cited_case) cited_groups,COALESCE(SUM(CAST(mention_count AS INTEGER)),0) printed_mentions,
 COALESCE(SUM(origin_known),0) origin_determined_edges,COALESCE(SUM(1-origin_known),0) origin_unknown_edges,
 COALESCE(SUM(foreign_status='FOREIGN'),0) foreign_edges,
 COALESCE(SUM(foreign_status='DOMESTIC_CA'),0) domestic_edges,
 COALESCE(SUM(foreign_status='CONFLICT'),0) origin_conflict_edges,
 COALESCE(SUM(edge_support='heuristic_only'),0) heuristic_only_edges,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN group_origin_known=1 THEN resolved_cited_case END) group_origin_determined,
 COALESCE(SUM(missing_document_metadata),0) edges_missing_document_metadata,
 COALESCE(SUM(source_year IS NULL),0) edges_unknown_source_year FROM b

origin_coverage_context.meaning: Only origin is removed; court/date/DD/kept/group constraints remain. Unknown origin is not foreign and is not extrapolated.

answer: Run run_20261016_country_complete: 42590 citation edges, 9326 citing source IDs, 27723 cited judgment groups. Origin determined for 42590/42590 edges; 0 unknown. Independently, 2828 edges have heuristic-only identity support. Ranked by distinct source judgment IDs in the selected scope: XC-G006640 (Anns v. Merton London Borough Council): 173; XC-G002463 (Donoghue v. Stevenson): 108; XC-G001223 (Quinn v. Leathem): 58; XC-G001161 (Salomon v. Salomon & Co): 52; XC-G004211 (Hedley Byrne & Co. v. Heller & Partners Ltd): 48. Before the origin filter, with all other filters unchanged: 490577 edges, 32693 unknown origin (including conflicts), 30881 heuristic-only. Foreign is 42590/490577 of all edges and 42590/457884 of origin-determined edges; a zero denominator means undefined. Unknown origin is not foreign and cannot be extrapolated as foreign. Counts show mentions, and do not establish whether a court followed a judgment.

capabilities.counting_meaning: An edge means a source judgment mentions a cited judgment identity group. It does not mean followed, relied on, agreed with, or binding authority.
capabilities.coverage_meaning: Origin coverage uses each edge's country assessment independently of identity confidence. Member country evidence can determine a heuristic identity edge's country; group-only inheritance requires identity support. Determined-only country shares cannot be extrapolated to unknown origins.
capabilities.date_meaning: Source judgment date chosen under the recorded corpus text policy; printed citation years are not used as judgment dates.
capabilities.document_denominator_meaning: Imported/supplied corpus metadata rows and distinct valid source IDs within court/date filters; empty-citation/empty/COURT_ IDs are excluded from source-ID denominators but retained in raw diagnostics. These are metadata-universe denominators, not counts of nonempty texts processed. Origin/DD/group filters affect the edge numerator only. Legacy absent text_policy is English-only; bilingual sources are never counted twice by a fallback.
capabilities.sampling_meaning: Evidence is a deterministic bounded preview, not a random sample or the basis for reported totals.
capabilities.accuracy: Structural validation is not semantic citation/identity accuracy; no fresh human calibration is implied.

warnings: Origin-filtered coverage describes the returned subset only. See origin_coverage_context for unknown/heuristic/conflict coverage before the origin filter within the same other constraints; unknown origin is not foreign.
